lines.t: Rise up, my love, my fair one, and come away
Follow the winter is past
The rain is over and gone
The flowers appear on the earth
The time of singing has come
And the voice of the turtle dove
Is heard in our land
Oh my dove, let me see your face
Let me hear your voice
For your voice is sweet and your face is lovely
The fig tree puts forth the green figs
And the vines with tender grapes
Give a fragrant smell
Rise up, my love, my fair one
And come away
Turn your eyes away from me
Oh, for they have overcome me
Oh, might of my perfect one
Oh, is she who looks forth as the morning
Oh, fair as the moon of your lips
Oh, my sister, my spouse
Oh, drip as the honeycomb
Honey and milk are under your tongue
Oh my dove, let me see your face, let me hear your voice
For your voice is sweet and your face is lovely
The fig tree puts forth the green figs and the vines with tender grapes
Give a fragrant smell, rise up my love, my fair one
And come away
You have ravished my heart
With one look into your eyes
Rise up my love, my fair one
And come up
Thank you for watching.
